# Azure Waves Realty Inc

> San Diego property management company. Full-service residential management for 8% of collected monthly rent, tenant placement only, and commercial leasing & advisory (nationwide).

Phone: (858) 304-0136
Email: contactusazw@gmail.com
Location: San Diego, California

## Pricing
- Full-Service Management: 8% of collected monthly rent; tenant placement fee is half of the first month's rent. No upfront costs.
- Tenant Placement Only: one month's rent ($750 minimum); no monthly fee.

## Our Promise
- We don't get paid unless you do: no management fee during vacancy or eviction.
- Eviction protection: up to $1,000 in attorney fees for non-payment evictions of tenants we placed.
- Maintenance response: urgent issues within 24 hours, non-urgent within 48 hours.
- Transparent communication: the Broker reaches out personally within 24 hours on request.
- Market rent analysis, re-evaluated at no extra charge if the property doesn't rent in the expected time.

## Services
- [Property Management](https://www.azwrealty.com/san-diego-property-management/)
- [Marketing & Leasing](https://www.azwrealty.com/marketing-and-leasing/): professional photos, top rental websites, showings 7 days a week
- [Tenant Screening & Leasing](https://www.azwrealty.com/tenant-screening-and-leasing/): income, credit, eviction, employment, criminal, lien, and rental reference checks
- [Rent Collection](https://www.azwrealty.com/rent-collection/): online payments; owner draws by the 10th of each month
- [Maintenance & Service](https://www.azwrealty.com/maintenance-service/): 24/7 emergency service, vetted vendors
- [Accounting](https://www.azwrealty.com/accounting/): monthly and annual owner statements
- [Pricing](https://www.azwrealty.com/pricing/)
- [Contact](https://www.azwrealty.com/contact/)
